alex: quick q — thinking of taking gateway_v2 canary offline if the 5xx spike keeps up. who is authorized to flip the service-level kill and what preflight should i run? :thinking:

maya: for a canary-only disable the oncall + the feature owner can toggle. global kills require 2-person approval (SRE lead + Eng Platform). we have a short preflight checklist.

ryan: +1. also check routing fallbacks and cache TTLs before you flip. global kills go through the web UI and need explicit approver in the audit comment.

alex: can someone paste the exact ffctl command? i want to run it from my laptop and include an audit reason.

maya: use ffctl for service-level toggles, e.g.

```
ffctl toggle --flag gateway_v2 --action disable --scope canary --by alex --reason "spike: 5xx up 3x" --audit "INC-2132"
```

maya: ops-bot will create an audit item automatically if you include --audit. for global kills you must also add --approver <user> and have second approver ack in the ticket.

ops-bot: [bot] audit entry created id=audit_202411_8f3c ; recorded_by=alex ; incident=INC-2132 ; notify=#eng-oncall

sre-lead: preflight checklist (quick):
- capture p95/p99 latency and 5xx rate (last 15m)
- list active canary cohort ids
- confirm fallback route + no single-point upstream
- verify cache TTLs and prefix caching won't lose critical keys
- create incident ticket (INC-2132) and assign owner

alex: re: auto re-enable — should we schedule a re-enable after 30m to reduce blast window?

sre-lead: we avoid auto re-enables for safety. if you want a timed re-enable, schedule it explicitly with owner and note it in the incident. ffctl supports --snooze <minutes> but it must be documented.

maya: also note for private deployments flipping requires VPN + KMS auth; double-check you have the right KMS key access. and please scrub any PII from the --reason field.

alex: thanks — i'll run the ffctl command with --audit INC-2132 and post results here. will tag oncall and keep a runbook note. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: [bot] reminder created: incident=INC-2132 ; owner=oncall ; followup=24h

ryan: after toggle, run `kubectl get pods -l canary=gateway_v2 -o wide` and watch request counts to confirm traffic shifted.

alex: got it, proceeding now. will update thread when done.
